title: Blackburrow
verify_gate: All three gates cleared 9 Aug 2026. Page fetched in full — all 16 named on the wiki are on the plate and respawn agrees at 22:00; history from the API, revision 165754, 4 August 2026, by Piano, though the only August edits are images so the content dates from 4 July; all 17 coordinates land on drawn floor. Two differ trivially from the wiki — Refugee Splitpaw (mnk) by 13 units, Splitpaw Sharpshooter by 4 — and both readings land on floor, so neither can be shown wrong and both are left as recorded.
respawn_note: eqlwiki infobox, page last edited 4 Aug 2026; corroborated by eqlwiki Zone_Spawn_Timers. UNRESOLVED, 11 Aug 2026: this note has said Blackburrow is not in the 28 July patch list, and eqlwiki's rendering of that note names six dungeons without it. A fuller quotation of the same note, supplied to us, names eleven including Blackburrow. Until we establish whether those are one note rendered two ways or two different notes, we do not know whether 22:00 is current or a pre-patch ceiling, and we are not guessing. One reading of the developers' own page settles it.

title: Plane of Fear
verify_gate: Gate 3 cannot be attempted here: no named coordinate is recorded for this zone, so there is nothing to check against the floor. Gates 1 and 2 are done - every boss page was checked against the MediaWiki revision API on 10 Aug 2026 and every one is a Project 1999 import. Measured in play: Cazic-Thule at Adaptive, Fused and Refined, with his full spell kit.
respawn_note: The published boss timers - 72 hours for the golems, 7 days for the dracoliche - describe an open-world spawn the 16 June 2026 patch note removed. They are not wrong so much as about a thing that no longer happens. Trash respawn is unrecorded by any source we have found.
placeholders_source: eqlwiki states Fear has no rare mobs with placeholders at all, which is a different claim from the dungeon placeholder removal. Not in the 28 July patch note, which named eleven dungeons and neither plane. So nothing has been published either way for this zone and we do not assume the dungeon change applied here.
